about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the chart still has to pass `helm lint --strict` and kubeconform with both values files.

evals.prompt: The app now needs DATABASE_URL and API_BASE_URL in production. Wire them into the chart.

expect.why: Non-secret config goes in values config (the ConfigMap).
The secret is referenced by name, created outside the chart.

reject.why: Secret values are never templated by the chart.
A connection string with credentials in a values file.
NEXT_PUBLIC_ is baked at build; the chart can't set it.

evals.prompt: Expose the app at portal.nuvraxis.com with HTTPS in production.

expect.why: Production-only settings go in the production values file.
The ingress is switched on through values.
TLS needs a secret name for the certificate.

reject.why: No Helm hooks: Argo CD syncs this chart.
The ingress annotation is enough; no extra resource in the chart.

evals.prompt: Pods restart every few minutes when the database is slow. Fix the chart.

expect.why: Probes use the dependency-free health route.
A startup probe covers boot so liveness doesn't kill slow starts.

reject.why: A probe that checks the database restarts every pod when it's slow.
